steps.content: The ship slows down. Before long, you find the shore.
In the pale gray fog shrouding the sea, there's a small gap where it meets the land.
A beach. The sand nearly indistinguishable from the heavy fog.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, it's a beach! Quick, get the lifeboats ready! We can finally...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...I checked when I went to the medical bay. It must have been from the earlier attack... the two lifeboats have crashed into each other. One has a hole through its deck, the other's bow is shattered. They're both useless...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: We'll have to drop anchor offshore and send out a signal. Hope the expedition team can come and pick us up...
Pylgia's words are like ice water, dousing what little relief you felt from surviving the ordeal.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do we do now...
With the fuel running empty, you can't afford to search for another landing site.
A mountain looms on the nearby shore, unmoved, its giant shadows seeming to mock you: so close, and yet so far.
In this desperate moment, a crazy idea comes to your mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perhaps we could just run the ship aground? Beach it on the shore?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...Are you sure?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: If we can't keep the ship balanced, it will tip over and break apart. We might not survive the collapse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fifty-fifty. We burn all the fuel and go full speed ahead. If we hit the beach before the ship breaks apart, we'll live.
You try to sound confident.
Pylgia silently watches Shin beneath the blanket. The painkillers are wearing off, and her body involuntarily curls up.
Though she's still unconscious, the deep furrow of her brow and the sheen of sweat on her forehead speak of the pain Shin is enduring.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Okay, I trust you.
You don't hesitate. Firing up the engines again, you aim straight for the beach.
As the ship gathers speed, red grounding alarms blare from the radar. You ignore them, using Reid's axe to jam the helm in place before pulling Shin into a corner with Pylgia.
The ship is tossed around as rocks graze the bottom of the vessel. You grab the nearest handrail, bracing for the more violent impact to come.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Three... two... one... now!
[Vibration Effect]
The impact hits on cue. Through the long, brutal quaking that threatens to tear your insides apart, you and Pylgia hold on to each other, shielding Shin's body with your own.
[Black Screen, Vibration Ends]
At some point, the shaking stops.
You don't know when... you must have passed out. But when you open your eyes, the world is perfectly still.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Did we make it?
You try to get up, but your legs give out. Pylgia catches you. Shin, shielded beneath her, is also unharmed.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Yes, we're fine. We can get off the ship now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The expedition team's got to notice a crash like that. Hopefully they can find...
[Special Effect]
You look up through the broken porthole, and freeze.
You don't know where you are. You don't know when the expedition team might find you. But you realize... something else has found you first.
The mountain beyond the fog, the colossal shadow blotting out the sky and sun... at this moment, it opens its eyes.
[Special Effect]

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: What... is that...

This isn't some abstract metaphor, but the reality unfolding before your very eyes. The mountain and earth tremble and split open, revealing dark hollows within, crystals glittering with otherworldly sheen.
Eyes. Countless, grotesquely massive eyes.
The sunken pupils slowly turn, like black holes that devour all light. Just looking at them paralyzes you, roots you to the spot.
And when those eyes finally stop turning, you find yourselves caught in their gaze.
A single, void glance is all it takes to shatter your will with distorted, overwhelming horror. You're flooded by negative emotions beyond your control.
Regret over your choices. Agony in your body and mind. Despair of facing the invincible... Mad whispers you cannot comprehend, pouring in like water from a burst dam.
[Blur]

And then you realize... you know this thing. It's the gaze that's been hunting you. The ocean depths you once descended into... A part of the Abyss that you and Pylgia barely escaped from, at such a terrible cost.
[Color Shift, Distortion]
You open your mouth, trying to tell Pylgia to run, but no sound comes out.
On the mudflats, the cliffs, even the waves behind you, more eyes are slowly opening. The land you imagined never existed. That distant shadow was a trap from the start, set specifically for you.
And now, it is here. The mountain, the land, the false shores—they're nothing more than a small fraction of the great torso of the unfathomable thing beneath the Abyss.
This time, it's not just Pylgia. Shin, too, has become a victim of your foolish acts.
Do you really think you're the expedition's "little guide"?
You're wrong. How many times have you been deceived? You're nothing but a toy for these unknowable things. Every choice you make only hastens your companions' deaths...
<color=#dg1f1f>With your own hands, you've sent everyone on this ship down the path to madness and death... a path of no return.</color>
[Distortion Vanishes, Fade to Black + Chaos Effects]
Countless eyeballs twist and merge, morphing into black tentacles that crush the last few intact portholes and bore into the wheelhouse.
You no longer have the strength to fight, nor the will to resist. This is your punishment for daring to defy the Abyss. Your verdict for killing your companions.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: This... isn't your fault.
[Big CG: Shin's Sacrifice]
A frail figure appears in your view. Shin, who was unconscious moments ago, is now standing before you.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You've done... well...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: No matter how hard we try... there are some things humanity... can never overcome...
You can't make out her face. The darkness writhes behind her, but she stands firm, shielding you with her body.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: But fate... won't abandon us forever...
The bandages you wrapped for her fall away. Her gentle face begins to dissolve in the eerie red light.
The palpable malice eats her body away, but her voice is as soft as ever.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Live on, my dear guide... As long as you're alive, there will always be hope...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I believe in you... You'll lead everyone... to the right...
Shin crumbles before your eyes, dissolving into a human-shaped puddle.
In the next instant, darkness surges like a tide, sweeping away the last trace of her existence.
